sourceFunctionIdentity.meaning: The bound recipe below is an independent majorant of these exact functions, with a generated finite-order recurrence.

I1.source: C12_FREQUENCY_CONTRACT.md §§1,3,4; certify_symbolic_c2.py; the same accepted source envelope R and N.
I1.matrixDefinition: The original continuous C.2 matrix with positive unit-mass bumps on [9,9.5], [10,10.5], [11,11.5], [12,12.5], [13,13.5].

determinantDerivation.U: w_lambda(x)=-integral_0^log(x) exp(-lambda*s) ds; w_lambda_prime=-x^(-1-lambda). The support gap gives |det A_U|>=1/200 and ||A_U^-1||_infty<800.
determinantDerivation.E: Factor x^(-3/2-lambda) from each point column. The remaining rows are sqrt(2)*x^(2+lambda), -x, 1. Positivity, ordered gaps >=1/2,3/2,1/2 and the divided-difference bound f[x,y,z]>=1 give |det A_E|>3/64000000. Every cofactor is <=12 and each adjugate row sum <=36.
determinantDerivation.continuousIntegrationPreservesLowerBound: Determinant multilinearity integrates the positive pointwise determinant against the product of the three positive unit-mass bump measures.

I1.normConvention: max over components, eta in [-1,1], and ordinary eta derivative orders 0,1,2. Product square costs <=4r^2, difference of squares <=8r*distance. These bounds also imply pointwise contraction.

I2.source: HEAT_COMPENSATION_PROOF_EN.md H5-H14, same accepted source I2, h and lambda.
I2.sourceInput: The three actual improper heat moment integrals, not their upper bounds.
I2.norm: maximum raw eta derivative order 0,1,2; square/difference bounds have factors 4 and 8

sourceChecks.proof: Xplus=Xv*e is inside the first unit of the positive 128-unit interpolation. Xtail and XK are later, so the heat edit itself vanishes on [0,Xplus]. Its full improper debt still enters I2.
t1>0 gives Xa*exp(t1/16)<loopILeft= Xa*exp(t1/8). The B26 norm up to Xi is restricted to this actual unchanged collar.
exp(Q^200)>Q^10200/51!>Q^10000; Q>=2^260. This is a value/tube bound, not a derivative-order absorption.
The preconditioned Jacobian inverse is <2. The same C0 root is differentiated; no C^m small-ball premise is asserted.
The exact continuous inverse is <2^30 and the preconditioned point Jacobian inverse is <2. Its old C2 smallness is used only to identify the C0 branch.
The actual improper heat debts, including their positive eta-dependent tails, define the same C0 root. New arbitrary eta derivatives use Gamma moments, not the old H9 C2 norm.
